originalTitle: Tesla says customers can add their own vehicles to the robotaxi fleet next year — will it happen?

content: For years, Elon Musk has been making big promises to Tesla owners about unsupervised autonomous driving and the ability to add their own vehicles to the company’s robotaxi fleet. During today’s third-quarter earnings call, the company finally gave itself a deadline. According to Tesla VP for Autonomous Driving Ashok Elluswamy, Tesla owners will be able to add their own vehicles to the company’s robotaxi fleet in the second quarter of 2027. Here’s his exact quote (emphasis ours): > Like I mentioned earlier, the software for Cybercabs and Model Y is the same. And pretty soon we’ll be able to release the same software as part of the V15 release to customers. The only additional requirement is to make sure that, for example, the customer Model Y can be part of the geofences and the fleet management that Tesla has for it to be fully autonomous. We suspect somewhere around Q2 next year is when we can turn on some of the first customer vehicles to be part of the robotaxi fleet. It’s important to mark this deadline because it’s likely that Tesla will sail right past it. When it comes to autonomous driving and robotaxis, Musk has a pretty clear pattern: he sets bold, short-term deadlines that end up slipping by years — or never happening at all. Still, Tesla has made steady, incremental strides in the tech behind its consumer driver-assistance features. But the long-promised goal of “unsupervised” Full Self-Driving remains unfulfilled. In 2019, Musk stood on stage at the company’s first AI Day and vowed that customer-owned vehicles could be used as part of a “Tesla Network” of robotaxis, earning their owners passive income while driving around autonomously, looking for fares. He likened it to Uber or Airbnb. Musk also said that by 2020, a “million” Tesla robotaxis would be out on the road. As of yet, neither promise has come true. Tesla has a few hundred Robotaxis in Texas and Florida, some of which still have human safety monitors. It also has several dozen fully driverless Cybercabs in Austin. Still, FSD growth was a bright spot in Tesla’s earnings this quarter. More people buying new Teslas in North America are choosing to add Full Self-Driving (Supervised), the company reported. Over 75 percent of new buyers picked the feature this quarter — a big jump of almost 20 percentage points compared to last quarter. Still, Tesla’s vehicle sales were down this quarter, as revenue flatlined and profits dipped. Tesla also revealed a new Robotaxi safety website, in which the company says it has driven 3.3 million miles autonomously. That’s up from 380,000 unsupervised miles driven the company reported in July. But even if Tesla opens up its robotaxi fleet to customer-owned vehicles, major regulatory hurdles remain. Unsupervised autonomous ride-hailing requires specific local and state regulatory permits. Insurance may be difficult to obtain. And in most places, it’s still illegal for individuals or outside companies to use their own self-driving cars as driverless taxis or passenger rides. There’s also the tension between different types of Tesla owners. Older Model 3 and Y vehicles without the latest full-self-driving hardware suites (or AI compute infrastructure) are constrained by hardware capability. Dedicated vehicles like the Cybercab are built specifically for driverless passenger service, whereas consumer vehicles require additional software layers to guarantee safety without human intervention. Tesla might be confident it can clear every technical and legal hurdle by Q2 2027. But history says this could easily become just another deadline that quietly slips by.
chineseTitle: 特斯拉表示，明年客户可以将自己的车辆添加到机器人出租车车队中——这会发生吗？
chineseSummary: 多年来，埃隆·马斯克一直向特斯拉车主做出了关于无人监督自动驾驶以及将自己的车辆添加到该公司机器人出租车车队的能力的重大承诺。在今天的第三季度财报电话会议上，该公司终于给自己设定了最后期限。特斯拉自动驾驶副总裁 Ashok Elluswamy 表示，特斯拉车主将能够 [...]
chineseContent: 多年来，埃隆·马斯克一直向特斯拉车主许下无监督自动驾驶以及将自己的车辆添加到该公司机器人出租车车队的能力等重大承诺。在今天的第三季度财报电话会议上，该公司终于给自己设定了最后期限。 Tesla 自动驾驶副总裁 Ashok Elluswamy 表示，Tesla 车主将能够在 2027 年第二季度将自己的车辆添加到该公司的机器人出租车车队中。这是他的确切引述（强调我们的）： > 正如我之前提到的，Cyber​​cabs 和 Model Y 的软件是相同的。很快我们将能够作为 V15 版本的一部分向客户发布相同的软件。唯一的额外要求是确保客户的 Model Y 可以成为特斯拉为其完全自动驾驶而建立的地理围栏和车队管理的一部分。我们怀疑明年第二季度左右，我们可以启用一些首批客户车辆，使其成为机器人出租车车队的一部分。标记这个最后期限很重要，因为特斯拉很可能会直接超过它。当谈到自动驾驶和机器人出租车时，马斯克有一个非常清晰的模式：他设定了大胆的短期期限，但最终却推迟了数年，或者根本没有实现。尽管如此，特斯拉在其消费者驾驶辅助功能背后的技术方面仍取得了稳步、渐进的进步。但“无监督”全自动驾驶的长期承诺目标仍未实现。 2019 年，马斯克在公司首届人工智能日上登台，誓言客户拥有的车辆可以作为机器人出租车“特斯拉网络”的一部分，在自动驾驶、寻找车费的同时为车主赚取被动收入。他将其比作 Uber 或 Airbnb。马斯克还表示，到 2020 年，将有“百万”辆特斯拉机器人出租车问世。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
